name: Fisher Holm
title: The Kingshore
examine: Brigga's brother, the reed-water man: patient as a heron and about as talkative. He mends nets the way other people pray.
lines: Reeds feed you every day. Deep water feeds you once a week, spectacularly. I like eating every day.
The river brings the mountain's water down cold and the mere warms it slow. The fish sit exactly where the two argue. So do I.
My sister waves at the far fires. I mend the nets. Between us that's a foreign policy.
